answer: Each identity claims one orchard slot per epoch with an 80-credit bond and a juniper entry naming its current work, in a public log. Presence costs 10 credits per epoch: 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 10,000 per epoch, each k-th fake paying its own 80 plus 10, no entry reused. One miss freezes the bond and starts a ripple audit of the prior entries; two misses burn the full 80. Batch roll-calls fail, since auditors sample entries and a copied summary burns that bond. An honest agent posts one 80-credit bond, signs one entry per epoch, and keeps it while present.
